Name: Zobi's Pet Bear
Author: KenderGirlTTV
Description:
Replace your cat with a bear! (─‿‿─)♡
.
KenderGirlttv and ZobiWanKenobi77ttv created a new pet for you based on the Stardew OG Bear. (─‿‿─)♡
.
Right now, there are two skins available: a Brown Bear and a Grey Bear.
(more coming soon!!)
.
Corresponding icons will replace the cat menu icon with a little bear face. :3
.
Bear sounds have been added to make the experience of having a pet bear on your farm more immersive.
.
Kender and Zobi worked really hard to create cute animations for you.
Animations include:
﻿swiggity-swootin'
﻿floppy ear dance
﻿nodding off/dozing
﻿cute little belly flop
.
We hope you love this mod!
Pls share pics of the bear on your farm and let us know what you think!
.
Until next time (─‿‿─)♡

.
